name: session_log
description: Retrieve conversation history from previous OADSON sessions — list recent sessions, or search past sessions by keyword to find a specific conversation, decision, or code snippet.

action.description: 'list' for recent sessions, 'search' for a keyword search across past session messages, 'get' to retrieve full messages for one session_id.

query.description: Keyword to search for in past session messages. Required when action='search'.

session_id.description: The session_id to fetch full messages for. Required when action='get'.

limit.description: Max number of sessions to return for 'list' or 'search'. Defaults to 10.
